## Summary

Closes #8.

Adds `CONTRIBUTOR_ONBOARDING.md` as a practical entry point for new contributors and links it from the README.

The guide covers:

- where to start: charter, meeting minutes, issues, and PRs
- public GitHub contribution flow versus member-only meeting/channel access
- current focus-area entry points grounded in the charter and public meeting minutes
- first-time contributor checklist
- good first contribution examples
- issue pickup and document-edit guidance
- focus-area self-nomination guidance
- sensitive-data reminders for trace examples

## Validation

- `git diff --check`
- ASCII check on `CONTRIBUTOR_ONBOARDING.md`
- Checked issue #8 acceptance criteria against the added sections

PR #13 also updates repository working methods and README navigation. If it lands first, I can rebase this branch so the README link sits in the preferred Start Here section.
